$comment: Authoritative pre-release v1 projection, derived from the Rust types by cargo run -p xtask -- derive. Do not hand-edit.

CommissioningRecordId.description: Identity of one append-only commissioning provenance record.

DelegationId.description: Identity of a delegation from one authority context to another.

EvidenceId.description: Identity of a provenance-bearing evidence record admitted for a claim.

EvidenceRecord.description: A provenance-bearing evidence record admitted for an exact subject.

independence.description: The producer's independence from the actor being judged.

method.description: The collection method (how the evidence was produced).

observed_at.description: Trusted observation time assigned by the admitting evidence store.

producer.description: The principal that produced the evidence.

producer_delegation.description: Exact delegation under which the producer emitted the record.

subject.description: Digest of the exact subject the evidence is about.

IndependenceClass.description: How independent the evidence producer is from the actor being judged.

oneOf.description:
The actor reports on itself (weakest; never satisfies an
independent-verification obligation).
A different agent produced the evidence.
A separate service produced the evidence.
A human authority produced or approved the evidence.

InstitutionId.description: Identity of one institution authority domain.

InstitutionWorkspaceId.description: Identity of one institution-owned commissioning workspace.

PrincipalId.description: Identity of an actor capable of requesting work.

RuntimeGenerationId.description:
Content-derived identity of an immutable runtime generation.

Unlike actor and record identifiers, a generation identity is never random:
the same canonical specialization inputs produce the same identity.

description: Evidence-bearing completion of operational handoff and commissioner revocation.

acceptance_delegation.description: Exact delegation carrying the accepting client's handoff authority.

accepted_by.description: Client principal accepting custody and continuity responsibility.

commissioner.description: Commissioner whose temporary authority was revoked or expired.

commissioning_record.description: Commissioning record incorporated into the generation.

commissioning_record_digest.description: Digest of that exact commissioning record.

continuity_evidence.description: Evidence that the operational generation remained functional afterward.

institution.description: Institution whose operation was handed off.

revocation_evidence.description: Evidence proving that commissioner authority was revoked or expired.

revoked_grant_digest.description: Digest of the complete revoked commissioner grant.

unresolved_obligations.description: Known unresolved obligations retained rather than narrated away.

unresolved_obligations_digest.description: Digest of the exact owner-approved obligation set.

workspace_digest.description: Digest of the preserved workspace snapshot.

title: HandoffReceipt
